description: The Jacobuskerk at Zeerijp is a medieval cruciform brick church with romanogothic arched brickwork. The bell tower stands apart from the church and has a saddle roof. A partial moat and an iron gate with block piers mark the churchyard. The church is closed. It is overcast, about 8.3°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h and cloud cover about 95%.
